mapper.update: UPDATE category_change_event SET status = 'PROCESSING', processing_token = #{processingToken}, processing_lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{leaseSeconds}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), updater = #{updater}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND ( next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM category_change_event WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_at IS NULL OR next_retry_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize}
mapper.update: UPDATE category_change_event SET status = 'PENDING', processing_token = NULL, processing_lease_until = NULL, next_retry_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, (retry_count + 1) * 30, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), retry_count = retry_count + 1, updater = #{updater}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = #{lastError} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE category_change_event SET status = 'FAILED', processing_token = NULL, processing_lease_until = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, retry_count = retry_count + 1, updater = #{updater}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = #{lastError} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE category_change_event SET status = 'SUCCESS', processing_token = NULL, processing_lease_until = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL, updater = #{updater}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, last_error = NULL WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE category_change_event SET status = CASE WHEN retry_count > 3 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, processing_token = NULL, processing_lease_until = NULL, next_retry_at = CASE WHEN retry_count > 3 THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, (retry_count + 1) * 30, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) END, retry_count = CASE WHEN retry_count > 3 THEN retry_count ELSE retry_count + 1 END, updater = #{updater}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND (processing_lease_until <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY processing_lease_until ASC limit 10
